Architectural Automation · Revit Add-in

Ceiling Wizard

Design suspended ceilings. Review and generate them in Revit.

Lay out gypsum and tile ceilings from room geometry. Review module sizes, borders, and elevations, then generate the selected rooms after the design is checked.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Watch Demos
Key features

Choose the right level of control for each ceiling

Use Full Gypsum or Full Tiles for straightforward rooms. Use Perimeter + Whole Tiles or Divided Bays when the design needs controlled borders, internal bands, or stepped transitions.

  • 01

    Four ceiling patterns

    Choose Full Gypsum, Full Tiles, Perimeter + Whole Tiles, or Divided Bays.

  • 02

    Tile module detection

    Read module sizes from Revit ceiling types and material surface patterns.

  • 03

    Full-tile grid review

    Start complete modules from two room edges and review the cuts at the other ends.

  • 04

    Gypsum borders and transitions

    Set border limits and review stepped transitions or vertical bulkheads where ceiling heights differ.

  • 05

    Divided-bay layouts

    Set gypsum bands, symmetric spans, and directional tile modules. Review the layout and tile counts.

  • 06

    Structural height checks

    Validate the proposed ceiling elevation against the lowest detected soffit, including loaded structural links.

  • 07

    Group similar rooms

    Use the confirmed design settings to identify compatible rooms and apply a representative layout.

  • 08

    Review, modify, and generate

    Work with host or linked rooms, review existing ceiling conditions, and generate the selected rooms together.
